title: Research: speaker diarization upgrade path from pyannote-community-1
objective: Survey speaker diarization options to replace the current pyannote-speaker-diarization-community-1 adapter in AI Media Factory. Compare: pyannote.audio 3.1 (MIT weights CC-BY-4.0, DER ~11-19% on AMI, best open-source balance), DiariZen/BUTSpeechFIT (MIT, WavLM-Large + Conformer, 13.3% DER – leading fully open benchmark), NVIDIA NeMo (Apache 2.0, ~80x realtime with Parakeet-TDT v3, GPU-optimised). For each: DER on standard benchmarks, license, GPU requirements, Python integration complexity, subprocess vs in-process model. Recommend upgrade path and whether to offer a high-accuracy mode selector. Write results to docs/research/RESEARCH-DIARIZATION-001.md only.
